strings.CnvQstEditor —— Grim Dawn .cnv / .qst 编辑:
CnvQstEditor — Grim Dawn .cnv / .qst editor

View, edit, create, import / export and batch-process. Format from Game.dll loader reverse engineering, validated on 446+ samples.

A three-check (tiling / locOffset / round-trip byte equality) runs before saving. Structural validity does not mean semantic correctness — verify unknown-semantics fields (yellow) in-game or in the official editor.
strings.从左侧选择节点开始查看 / 编辑，或直接把 .cnv / .qst 文件（目录也:
Select a node on the left to view / edit, or drag .cnv / .qst files (folders too) into the window.

· Export saves TXT / JSON / dump tree text
· Import backfills official localization TXT or JSON
· Saving runs the three-check and creates a .bak backup
